# MunchGud - Premium Roasted Makhana
Welcome to the MunchGud website. We are a direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand offering premium, high-protein, gluten-free roasted makhana (fox nuts) sourced directly from the farms of Bihar.

## Products
- Classic Salted Makhana
- Cheese & Herbs Makhana
- Himalayan Pink Salt Makhana
- Peri Peri Makhana
- Cream & Onion Makhana
- Build a Box (Custom Combos)
